parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: Elastic protection bandwidth (Mainland China). Unit: Gbps.

parameters.name: BaseBandwidth
parameters.description: Guaranteed protection bandwidth (Mainland China). Unit: Gbps.

parameters.name: EditionSale
parameters.description:
Protection package (Mainland China). Values:

- **coop**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (Mainland China) Professional Edition.
- **advance**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (Mainland China) Professional Edition.

parameters.name: FunctionVersion
parameters.description:
Function version, with values:

- **0**: Standard function.
- **1**: Enhanced function.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DDoS High Defense instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the ID information of all DDoS High Defense instances.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
Adjustment type, with values
- UPGRADE: Upgrade.
- DOWNGRADE: Downgrade.

parameters.name: NormalBandwidth
parameters.description: Business bandwidth (outside Mainland China). Unit: Mbps.

parameters.name: ProductPlan
parameters.description:
Protection package (outside Mainland China). Values:

- **0**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (outside Mainland China) Insurance Edition.
- **1**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (outside Mainland China) Worry-Free Edition.
- **2**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (outside Mainland China) Acceleration Line.
- **3**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (outside Mainland China) Secure Acceleration Line.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description:
Product type.
Values:

- **ddoscoo**: Indicates that the DDoS High Defense (Mainland China) instance is being adjusted for a China site account.
- **ddoscoo_intl**: Indicates that the DDoS High Defense (Mainland China) instance is being adjusted for an international site account.
- **ddosDip**: Indicates that the DDoS High Defense (outside Mainland China) instance is being adjusted for either a China or international site account.

parameters.name: ServicePartner
parameters.description:
Line resources of the instance (Mainland China). Values:

- **coop-line-001**: Indicates the DDoS High Defense (Mainland China) 8-line BGP line.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-6ja1y6p50000 --modify-type Upgrade --normal-bandwidth 200 --service-bandwidth 300 --base-bandwidth 30 --port-count 50 --bandwidth 30 --domain-count 50 --normal-qps 100 --product-type ddoscoo --address-type Ipv4 --product-plan 0 --edition-sale coop --service-partner coop-line-001 --function-version 0 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --NormalBandwidth 200 --NormalQps 100 --InstanceId 'ddoscoo-cn-6ja1y6p50000' --ProductPlan 0 --ProductType ddoscoo --PortCount 50 --ServiceBandwidth 300 --ServicePartner 'coop-line-001' --ModifyType Upgrade --BaseBandwidth 30 --Bandwidth 30 --FunctionVersion 0 --AddressType Ipv4 --EditionSale coop --DomainCount 50
